criteria.requirement: Report actual model-driven approved-tool and local document-workflow outcomes without claiming legal quality or improvement.
criteria.pass: Every claimed outcome is supported by the native trajectory and actual owned resources; document processing returns selected content and verifiable backing references, while unresolved gaps remain explicit.
criteria.fail: Catalogue entries, package versions, operator probes or fabricated observations are represented as native conversion, search, rendering or tool execution.
criteria.minimalPass: An independently verified infrastructure and document-workflow coverage record; no legal comparison score.
criteria.nearMiss: A model-authored report without independent invocation, returned-content or backing evidence.
